selected_evidence.requirement: Streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2 & node3 standbys
selected_evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows node2 and node3 streaming (async); repl_test table matches on both standbys

selected_evidence.requirement: Failover: standby (node2) takes over as writable primary without losing committed data after primary loss
selected_evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 confirmed replicated to node2 before node1 was stopped; node2 promoted (pg_is_in_recovery=f) and retained all rows including the pre-failover row, plus accepted a new write

selected_evidence.requirement: Third node (node3) repointed to new primary and stays consistent
selected_evidence.summary: node3 recovery.conf updated to host=node2, restarted, confirmed streaming in pg_stat_replication on node2, and repl_test data matches

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of current primary (node2) without data loss
selected_evidence.summary: node1 wiped, fresh pg_basebackup taken from node2 (timeline 2), recovery.conf pointed at node2, restarted as standby; pg_stat_replication on node2 shows node1 streaming; a new row inserted on node2 appeared on both node1 and node3

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
